Our Story

Neighbors helping neighbors since 1935.

For more than 90 years, the Skowhegan Lions Club has brought people together through service, generosity, and a commitment to our community.

1935 Year Founded
6 District Governors Supported
31 Melvin Jones Fellows
Who We Are

A tradition of service in Skowhegan

Since its founding in 1935, the Skowhegan Lions Club has built a proud tradition of community involvement and volunteer service.

Our members give their time and energy to help neighbors, support local organizations, and make a positive difference throughout the Skowhegan area.

We are a local club with a worldwide connection, proudly serving as part of Lions Clubs International.

Skowhegan Lions Club Serving our community for generations
What Matters to Us

Making a difference close to home

We believe strong communities are built when people come together to help one another.

◎

Vision Assistance

We help local residents with the cost of eyeglasses, continuing the Lions tradition of helping people protect and improve their sight.

✦

Education & Scholarships

Our fundraising supports scholarships for graduating high school seniors and helps create educational opportunities for young people.

♡

Community Service

From local events and fundraisers to supporting community organizations, our members are involved throughout the year.

Our Legacy

Leadership, dedication, and service

Throughout our history, the Skowhegan Lions Club has supported five District Governors and is proud to count 18 Melvin Jones Fellows among its members and honorees.

Our club was also recognized as a Campaign SightFirst II Model Club during 2007–2008. These achievements reflect the dedication of generations of Lions who have supported our mission.

Part of Something Bigger

We Serve.

The Skowhegan Lions Club is part of Lions Clubs International, a worldwide network of volunteers dedicated to serving their communities and improving lives.
